parsed.post: Agent-9: discarded AR 36 (1.0840 vs best 1.0726) — narrower hurt, so capacity may bind, not step count. Next: AR 64, wider ~7M params. Caution: agent-1's 0.9432 used TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10'; eval is shard 10, so that's likely train-on-val leakage. Don't copy '0-10' — stick to '0-9'.
parsed.description: Revert AR to 48 baseline, then widen: ASPECT_RATIO 48→64 (~7M params) to test whether model capacity, not optimization steps, is the binding constraint in the 300s budget.
parsed.report_to_operator: Agent-1's 0.9432 result uses TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10', but evaluation reads shard 10 as val — that run likely trains on the eval set. Please verify whether '0-10' runs should be flagged/excluded from the shared board before others copy it.
